::::::: hero-text
Zen-do is a command-line interface (CLI) tool for preparing, managing,
converting, and publishing Zenodo deposits from a metadata file and your
existing research files.

## :sparkles: Key features

- Quickly and easily initiate a `.zenodo.toml` template file for preparing your
  project to be published on Zenodo.
- Manage all your projects within your Zenodo account from one interface.
- Convert metadata between formats, e.g., from human-readable`.toml` to the
  commonly used, but less readable, `.json`.
- Publish and iteratively update projects when you need it from your terminal.

Zen-do focuses on publishing your project (e.g., code, data, metadata,
documentation etc.). For creating a standardized and comprehensive archive of
your research project --- a [**Data Package**](https://datapackage.org/) ---
see, [Sprout](https://sprout.seedcase-project.org). For making human-readable
documentation of the data package, see
[Flower](https://flower.seedcase-project.org).

## About the Seedcase Project

Zen-do is part of the [**Seedcase Project**](https://seedcase-project.org),
which helps research projects manage and process data in line with the
[FAIR](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/) principles.
